title: Corpus Staleness Alert (FR-RAG-FRESH-02)
description: Wire format for the `corpus_stale` alert emitted to on-call + Service Bus when the corpus has gone stale (per ADR-17 + FR-RAG-FRESH-02). Scope is the global corpus index (single signal per Pass 1 Q-P1-05) — NOT per-jurisdiction or per-topic partition. One alert per `corpus_build_sha` age threshold breach. Disable path is `feature.corpus_freshness_alert.enabled` (Reversible class per A12); when disabled, alert is suppressed but underlying staleness state is still recorded in the audit log.

alert_id.description: UUID v7 (time-ordered). Used by on-call + downstream incident management to deduplicate.

alert_type.description: Discriminator. Always `corpus_stale` for FR-RAG-FRESH-02. Distinct from FR-RAG-FRESH-01 in-UI freshness indicator (which is a UI signal, not an alert).

emitted_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of alert emission.

corpus_build_sha.description: SHA-256 of the current corpus build manifest; same value as `AuditRecord.corpus_build_sha`.

corpus_generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC `generated_at` from the corpus manifest. Drives the age computation.

corpus_age_days.description: Age in days = (emitted_at - corpus_generated_at). MUST be >=14 per FR-RAG-FRESH-02 trigger.

last_ingest_run_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last successful ingest job execution (per FR-RAG-IDX-05a nightly schedule). Null if no ingest has ever run.

last_ingest_run_age_hours.description: Hours since the last successful ingest run. MUST be >=48 per FR-RAG-FRESH-02 trigger (the 48-hour grace prevents transient alert noise during in-flight rebuilds). If `last_ingest_run_at` is null, set to a sentinel large value (e.g. 999999) and on-call treats it as 'no ingest history'.

severity.description: UI/operational severity. Both severities only fire when FR-RAG-FRESH-02 trigger is met (corpus_age_days >=14 AND last_ingest_run_age_hours >=48). `yellow` = corpus_age_days in [14, 17) (lower-band SOFT-warn for reactive teams that opt into early signals while drift remediation is in flight); `red` = corpus_age_days >=17 (hard alert; on-call paging escalates). The FR-RAG-FRESH-01 in-UI freshness indicator (yellow at >7 days, red at >14 days) is a separate UI signal — NOT this alert. The yellow→red boundary at 17 days is chosen so that even a same-week drift-remediation cycle has 3 days to turn the alert red before paging escalation.

feature_flag_state.description: State of the disable path per Pass 2 Q-P2-08. When `enabled == false`, the alert is suppressed but the underlying state is still recorded in the audit log; this object is included so downstream consumers know the alert was generated under the disabled-path semantics.

actor_id.description: Last actor who flipped the flag (null if never flipped).

remediation_link.description: Optional. Pointer to the runbook step for remediation (e.g. `https://github.com/johnbilliris/ama/blob/main/docs/runbooks/036-foundry-rag-corpus-stale.md`).

correlation_id.description: Trace correlation across alert -> Service Bus -> on-call paging.
